verdict.justification: The project proposes the development of a tool for providing adaptive assistance in e-learning environments, focusing on personalizing the assistance using software agent technology. The goal is to provide intelligence (adaptability) to the assistance in e-learning environments, taking into account the needs of users and their development within the platform. A prototype and method were created that allows the assignment and tracking of assistance to e-learning users. As a case study, Lingweb 'Virtual Learning Environment for Language Learning' was worked on. The platform was developed between December 2007 and June 2010 in a co-financing arrangement between the Universidad del Valle and Colciencias.
